name: Xabi Alonso
scopeNote: Xabi Alonso as head coach. Counted: Bayer Leverkusen 2022-10-05 to 2025-05-31 (3-4-2-1 / 3-4-3 with a back five out of possession, positional play, central progression, hybrid man/zonal press; sources use '3-4-2-1' (bundesliga.com) and '3-4-3' (Coaches' Voice) for the same base) and Real Madrid 2025-06-01 to 2026-01-12 (34 matches, short; built on the same principles plus a double pivot and more pressing, per Opta). Partial dates are used for the excluded spells (years only, from memory/Football Espana) and for several eventDates (season or month) when the day could not be found. The Leverkusen end date and the Real Madrid start date come from the club announcement of 2025-05-25 and a search summary, not a mined page (see openQuestions). Real Sociedad B coverage in the Coaches' Voice pages is not used as evidence.
openQuestions: Leverkusen end date 2025-05-31 and Real Madrid start date 2025-06-01 come from a search summary (club statement 'from June 1, 2025 until June 30, 2028') and are not in a mined paragraph; Sports Mole only confirms 'Appointed on May 25'. Leverkusen's last match (Bundesliga finale, mid-May 2025) is from memory, not checked.

Real Madrid spell is short (34 matches per Sports Mole, ~7 months) and ended 2026-01-12 ('mutually agreed', widely reported as a sacking after the 3-2 Super Cup final loss to Barcelona on 2026-01-11); tactical coverage is mostly Opta (pre-season and September 2025) and press columns, so late-spell evidence is thin. Included because Real Madrid is a bigger job and he stayed through 34 matches.

Real Sociedad B excluded: third/second-tier B team, dates not verified (football-espana says 'two seasons', memory says 2019-2022), and no in-period evidence was mined from it for the 12 axes; the Coaches' Voice pages give its style (4-2-3-1/4-3-3, high press, wingers keeping width, 3-4-3 in the last year) as an influence only.

The Bayern quote 'We can dominate the game, but sometimes we also have to wait and defend in a compact way' is dated 2024-02 from the Tactics Corner article (2024-02-16); the exact press conference date was not found.
The 2022/23 Coaches' Voice piece calls the system 3-5-2/3-4-3 and the 2023/24 bundesliga.com piece 3-4-2-1; both describe a back three with wing-backs, labels differ with the number of forwards/10s.

Marking: Coaches' Voice (2022/23) says 'mixed-marking' out of possession; SempreMilan (2024/25) says a hybrid press (aggressive high, zonal in own half); bundesliga.com (Bayern, 2024) says one-to-one at the back and mirroring Bayern's back three. A search summary also claimed full-pitch man-to-man vs Bayern from a bundesliga.com piece that was not mined, so not used.
The Grimaldo quote has no original date; 2025-06 is the Opta article month (2025-06-18), the quote predates it.

Real Madrid dressing-room claims (Goal reports of players' attitude, Vinicius/Rodrygo/Valverde friction) were only in search summaries or a columnist (El Debate) and are not verified facts of conflict.
